EORR_WORLDSPLITTER_SIGNATURE_LEGENDARY_D: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Deals +25% damage to enemies above 75% Health. PENALTY: -10 Speed and -6 Evasion. FLAVOR: A weapon made without subtlety. Kingdoms once used smaller objects as siege engines.
EORR_THE_LAST_ARGUMENT_LEGENDARY_DESCRIP: LEGENDARY EFFECT: The first firearm attack each combat deals +25% damage, gains +15% Critical Chance, and ignores Armor. FLAVOR: Diplomacy ends when its first chamber speaks.
EORR_GLASS_CANNON_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Exceptional raw firearm damage. PENALTY: -12 Vitality, -8 Evasion, and -2 Resistance. FLAVOR: Six chambers, no restraint, and absolutely no concern for the person holding it.
EORR_BLOODLETTER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Damage rises as Health falls: +5% below 75%, +10% below 50%, and +15% below 25%. FLAVOR: It never asks whose blood pays the balance.
EORR_EXECUTIONER_S_PROMISE_LEGENDARY_DES: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Deals +25% damage to enemies below 30% Health, reduced to +15% against bosses. PENALTY: -4 Speed. FLAVOR: Every swing is a sentence waiting for its period.
EORR_TITANBREAKER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Perfect attacks against targets with at least 5 Armor gain 75% Armor Pierce, +15% damage, and apply Armor Down. PENALTY: -12 Speed. FLAVOR: Fortifications are merely enemies that forgot how to move.
EORR_SPELLRAZOR_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Perfect attacks alternate between Armor Down and Resistance Down. FLAVOR: Its edge cannot decide whether flesh or magic is easier to cut.
EORR_TRIUNE_STAFF_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Changing to a different Fire, Ice, or Shock attack grants +15% damage. Repeating an element grants no bonus. FLAVOR: Three answers bound around one impossible question.
EORR_STARFALL_GRIMOIRE_LEGENDARY_DESCRIP: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Every third successful perfect Intelligence attack deals 6 nonlethal magical splash damage to all other enemies. The sequence resets each combat. FLAVOR: The margins chart constellations that have not fallen yet.
EORR_ARCHMAGE_S_FOLLY_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPT: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Overwhelming magical output with no defensive safeguard. PENALTY: -3 Armor and -6 Resistance. FLAVOR: The mage who made it achieved unimaginable power. Briefly.
EORR_GRAVEBOUND_TOME_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTI: LEGENDARY EFFECT: A Necromancer holding at least 1 Soul deals +15% damage. Other wielders retain its strong Intelligence magic. FLAVOR: Every page is warm, though none remember sunlight.
EORR_REAPER_S_SCEPTER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPT: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Killing an enemy restores 5 Health, limited to once per round even on multi-kills. FLAVOR: It takes a life with one hand and returns a fragment with the other.
EORR_PLAGUEBRINGER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Deals +5% damage per distinct harmful status on the target, up to +20%. FLAVOR: The cure was lost somewhere between the first and final draft.
EORR_STORMCALLER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Perfect attacks have a 25% chance to Shock. Attacks against Shocked targets deal +15% damage; immune targets receive Resistance Down instead. FLAVOR: Thunder answers, even when no one remembers asking.
EORR_FLOWING_RIVER_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPTION: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Consecutive successful direct attacks grant +4% damage each, up to +12%. Failing or taking direct damage resets the flow. FLAVOR: Stone resists. Water arrives anyway.
EORR_RAVAGER_S_HARNESS_LEGENDARY_DESCRIP: LEGENDARY EFFECT: A major physical offense package. PENALTY: -3 Armor and -4 Resistance. FLAVOR: Protection was removed wherever it interfered with swinging harder.
EORR_ROBES_OF_THE_VOID_LEGENDARY_DESCRIP: LEGENDARY EFFECT: While at maximum Focus, magical attacks deal +12% damage. PENALTY: -4 Armor and -2 Evasion. FLAVOR: Empty space has never felt so heavy.
EORR_WINDWALKER_S_GARB_LEGENDARY_DESCRIP: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Extreme mobility through +16 Speed and +12 Evasion. PENALTY: -4 Armor. FLAVOR: The wind leaves no footprints and accepts no armor.
EORR_TITAN_S_CARAPACE_LEGENDARY_DESCRIPT: LEGENDARY EFFECT: Extreme durability with +12 Armor, +4 Resistance, and +16 Vitality. PENALTY: -18 Speed and -10 Evasion. FLAVOR: Moving in it is optional. Surviving is not.

EOR_RESOURCE_DRUID_SUMMER_TOOLTIP: Summer is loaded: the next landed direct attack Burns its target.

EOR_RESOURCE_KNIGHT_VALOR_TOOLTIP: Landed direct attacks build Valor. Perfect attacks build 2. Reaching 3 Valor triggers Stand Guard.
EOR_RESOURCE_ORACLE_FORESIGHT_TOOLTIP: Landed direct Intelligence attacks build Foresight. Perfect attacks build 2. At 3, the next enemy direct action triggers Premonition.
EOR_RESOURCE_PALADIN_GRACE_TOOLTIP: Landed direct attacks or healing another hero build Grace. Perfect actions build 2. At 3, Divine Grace cleanses and protects the party.
EOR_RESOURCE_CHRONOMANCER_TEMPO_TOOLTIP: Landed direct Intelligence attacks build Tempo. Perfect attacks build 2. At 4, Time Slip empowers the slowest living hero.
EOR_RESOURCE_BLADEDANCER_FLOW_TOOLTIP: Landed direct attacks build Flow. Flow grants Speed and Evasion. At 3, the next landed direct attack Flourishes.
EOR_RESOURCE_FORTUNEBORN_LUCK_TOOLTIP: Failed direct skill-roll attacks build Luck. Critical failures build 2. At 3, the next landed direct attack cashes in Loaded Fortune.
EOR_RESOURCE_GLADIATOR_FAVOR_TOOLTIP: Critical hits, killing blows, and surviving punishment build Crowd Favor. At 3, Roar of the Crowd triggers.
EOR_RESOURCE_TEMPLAR_ZEAL_TOOLTIP: New harmful statuses suffered during combat build Zeal. At 3, Martyrdom heals, cleanses, and protects the party.
